content.text:
Can you pull companies that match the following screener using My_data FMP pull scripts and other API available? 

Search SEC/news for spin-off/separation/Form 10

Then full financials--> within 24 months netDebt/EBITDA <3; insider ownership/buying; revenue growth positive

I’ll use the My_Data signal/source workflow here, first checking the existing FMP/SEC/news pullers and schemas so the scan uses the vault’s own interfaces instead of inventing a one-off scrape. Then I’ll run or wire the smallest command path that can produce a dated candidate list.

I’m applying the My_Data signal triage and source quality rules for this scan. I’m checking command coverage now: whether there’s already a company-risk, FMP screener, SEC, or news workflow that can be composed into this screen.
`rg` is not installed in this shell, so I’m falling back to PowerShell search. The README confirms raw FMP/SEC/news acquisition is manual and allowed here because you explicitly requested it.

The existing CLI has the pieces but not this exact “spin-off plus leverage plus insider/revenue” compound screen. I’m reading the FMP client and SEC helpers next; if they expose the needed endpoints cleanly, I’ll add a narrow puller rather than doing the screen outside the system.

I found SEC EFTS full-text support in `scripts/lib/edgar.mjs`, which is the right discovery layer for “spin-off / separation / Form 10”. I’m going to sample that response shape before editing so the puller records the correct accession, company, CIK, and filing URL fields.

The FMP insider endpoint is returning 404 in this environment, so I’m going to use SEC Form 4 XML as the insider-buying source and keep FMP for profile, statements, key metrics, and company news. That gives the screen two independent channels: SEC filings for the event and insider activity, FMP for financials/news.

I’m adding a dedicated `spinoff-screen` puller now. It will write an immutable dated note under `05_Data_Pulls/Fundamentals/`, with SEC event evidence, FMP financial filters, SEC Form 4 buy checks, and keyword-filtered company news.
The puller is in place. I’m running it dry first with a smaller candidate cap to catch endpoint/schema problems before writing the dated note.

The first dry run exceeded two minutes, mostly because each candidate can require multiple SEC/FMP calls. I’m tightening the test run and will add bounded concurrency/less Form 4 depth if needed before running the full screen.

The small dry run works and found candidates, but the full version is too slow because it checks Form 4 XML for every SEC hit. I’m moving the insider-buy XML pass behind the financial filters, so it only does the expensive SEC ownership check for companies that already pass leverage and revenue growth.
